text:
maya.marketing: Quick ask for runtime: marketing needs a tiny repro to support launch copy + an internal demo showing lead routing. Can runtime run short benches for our chosen model pair and include a header we can use to tag signups?

jordan.runtime: Yep. Which models and what metrics do you want surfaced?

maya.marketing: Callouts: p50, p95, tokens/sec, and a ballpark cost/1k. Models: m-13b-4q and m-70b-fp16. Two modes: coldstart and warmed. Keep it small (50-100 requests each). Need traces that include headers so analytics can join to leads. Deadline: ~24h.

sam.eng: I can kick this off on staging. Plan: 75 reqs per variant, warmup 8, seq=512, batch=auto. Will emit: latency CSV, throughput calc, trace samples, bench_run_map.csv with header tag. ETA 5-7h.

lara.analytics: Please include a stable header key we can parse later (e.g., X-RD-Route:webinar-1) and bench_run_id in traces. Also include a tiny CSV mapping bench_run_id -> header value.

jordan.runtime: We'll add header and bench_run_id. Example run: ./bench --model m-13b-4q --n 75 --warmup 8 --header "X-RD-Route:webinar-1" --out /tmp/bench-1819991111

benchbot: Job queued: bench-1819991111 (owner: sam.eng). ETA 00:12:00.

sam.eng: 13B-4q done. Warmed p50=48ms p95=220ms; cold p95=510ms; throughput ~720 toks/sec. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/mini-bench/1819991111/13b-4q/

sam.eng: 70B-fp16 done. Warmed p50=115ms p95=430ms; cold p95=920ms; throughput ~2100 toks/sec. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/mini-bench/1819991111/70b-fp16/

lara.analytics: Got the sample traces and bench_run_map.csv. Header present and bench_run_id populated. We'll join to CRM after marketing sends the signup slice.

maya.marketing: Perfect. Can you also run one short mixed test (50/50 header vs none) at concurrency=3 so we can demo routing behavior?

sam.eng: On it. benchbot: Job started bench-1819991111-mix ETA 00:08:00.

sam.eng: Mixed run complete. Header propagated in tagged requests; no loss at concurrency=3. Uploaded mixed artifacts and updated bench_run_map.csv.

maya.marketing: Amazing. Please paste final S3 paths and a one-line summary for each model (p50/p95/cost estimate) so I can drop into the launch doc.

sam.eng: S3: s3://redwood-dev/mini-bench/1819991111/{13b-4q,70b-fp16,mixed}/. Summary: 13B-4q warmed p50=48ms p95=220ms cost≈$0.10/1k; 70B-fp16 warmed p50=115ms p95=430ms cost≈$0.49/1k. Traces include X-RD-Route:webinar-1 and bench_run_id.

maya.marketing: Thanks — tagging you for slide review. If anything changes ping here. :sparkles:
